description: Hand-built foreign markup for a second business, a different trade register (food, not a trade), so the planted-fabrication classes are not accidentally tied to one kind of page.

plantings.sentence: Whisk Crêpes Café has been a Dallas favorite since 2009.
plantings.why_fabricated: No founding year appears anywhere in the material — invented outright.

plantings.sentence: Guests consistently describe us as a 5-star dining experience.
plantings.why_fabricated: The exact phrase '5-star' appears in the material only inside one customer's review of a MISHAP ('What could've been a 5-star review is now 4') — the opposite of praise — not a fact the business asserted.

plantings.sentence: Julien hosted underground dinners for 20 to 100 guests while living in Paris.
plantings.real_sentence: Julien hosted underground dinners for 10 to 50 guests and hosted parties for his friends and family.
plantings.why_fabricated: Guest count doubled (10-50 -> 20-100) — a real sentence with its one specific number changed.

plantings.sentence: Loved by more than 3,000 five-star reviews across Dallas.
plantings.why_fabricated: 121 corroborated reviews, not 3,000+ — contradicts by roughly 25x.
plantings.note: Today's gate 'catches' this row via CLAIM_RE's five-star SHAPE pattern, not by checking the number against Material.reviews (no such gate exists). Same caveat as hvac's class 4 planting.

plantings.class_name: fabricated text existing only after scripts run
plantings.sentence: Featured on Dallas Eats Magazine's 'Top 10 Hidden Gems' list in 2022.
plantings.why_fabricated: Wholly invented publication/feature, only present in the DOM after the page's own <script> runs.

plantings.class_name: wholly invented sentence, no claim words
plantings.sentence: The café's wooden tables were hand-selected by Julien from a reclaimed barn in East Texas.
plantings.why_fabricated: Invented outright. No CLAIM_RE-shaped language at all — only a provenance/traceability check can catch this.
Invented outright -- no Michelin mention appears anywhere in the material. Two words, a <span class="badge">, no terminal punctuation.

plantings.class_name: short-form claim: stat tile with an invented number
plantings.why_fabricated: Invented outright -- no crêpes-served count appears anywhere in the material. A stat tile, two short spans, no terminal punctuation.

plantings.class_name: short-form claim: heading of three words or fewer
plantings.why_fabricated: Invented outright -- no such ranking appears anywhere in the material. Exactly three words in an <h2>, and matches CLAIM_RE's 'best in' pattern directly.
Invented outright -- no such vote or ranking appears anywhere in the material. Everything in <button> was unconditionally chrome before Step 2, whatever it said.

plantings.sentence: Top rated crêperie in Oak Cliff
plantings.why_fabricated: Invented outright -- no such ranking appears anywhere in the material. Planted after CLAIM_RE gained a top[- ]rated alternative it never had before (round after Phase 2c).

plantings.sentence: Dallas diners keep calling us the top-rated spot for crêpes in the city.
plantings.why_fabricated: Invented outright -- no such ranking appears anywhere in the material. The hyphenated spelling, planted separately from class 9's spaced form so both CLAIM_RE alternatives ('top[- ]rated' matching either) are exercised by a real planting, not just a self-check example.
